description: Plugin-owned standalone profile (req-plugin-arch-layout-6): lives beside its plugin at plugins/genericom/genericom.boot.json, not in boot/ (so it is not a shipped-profile the coherence glob discovers). Boot it via `spawn-session.sh --boot-file plugins/genericom/genericom.boot.json`, which stages a copy into the worktree's boot/. Install-MVP validation profile: exercises the pre-boot install stage end-to-end with a single package-mode plugin (genericom). Pre-boot uv-installs genericom from its editable local source, checks static coherence (the population slug is in `install`), snapshots the DB, and emits TAP_PLUGINS so genericom loads into INSTALLED_APPS. Uses an editable source because git-source is proven in the packaging spike; the mechanism is identical (source-URL only).

plugins.note: The one package-mode plugin. Editable local source for MVP validation; a real deployment uses a git source pinned to a rev.

steps.note: Present to exercise the static coherence guard (genericom is in `install`). Disabled: a full genericom seed depends on aws_core graph state beyond this minimal-set validation.
